method: learned set-conditioned candidate proposer; no plant/column rules or hand-weighted acquisition score

training.continuation: v29/v3/2500/mask61; branch1 static features; common future seeds across actions
training.root_sampling: up to24 teacher-search states/game,12wave0..3 and12later,fill shortages from remaining searchstates; no plant/cell filters
training.target: mean over training futures of positive improvement over the best member of the supplied candidate set; contexts are legacy set,legacy+oracle,legacy+random; learns complementary coverage from data
training.model: MLP state encoder64;action encoder32;mean/max selected-action embeddings;head64 sigmoid; root features from existing value featurizer and task context; action features cost,student/static scores/ranks/gaps,learned one-hot cell/packet representation
training.fit: train-only normalization; Adam lr0.001 weight_decay0.0001,80 epochs,batch8contexts,seed20261020; lowest validation MSE checkpoint; no tuning on600 evaluation states

acceptance.selection: exact task9 original300A+300B; exact236B+83A significant witness actions frompoint_statistics
acceptance.seed: D=seed*10000+decision-1; same original future seeds; only candidate additions differ
metrics: exact witness inclusion and final selection
old/old and new/new reseed noise for each budget
actual halving+verification continuation counts and increase
added candidates by cost/card and new represented cells/rows/columns,reported only,not policy rules
acceptance.confidence: game-cluster bootstrap for agreement/count increases;Wilson for class-specific witness inclusion;pool uses game clustering because A/B can share game
invariants: default off reproduces all600 original labels/rounded targets
existing candidates never removed or reordered
model frozen before evaluating; report all budgets, no retuning on testcases
acceptance.no_win_claim: main owns student retraining and win evaluation; leaf improvements need not improve wins

resources: at most4 own game processes; pause own subtree below2GiB, resume>=3GiB; no production jobs paused
task10: structured CUDA summary_json; results/leaf bytes unchanged, JSON rounded timing equals same-run old console parser; baseline parser no longer used inbench
delivery: cuda-h8 local; review branch cuda-merge may be pushed after validation; keep pvz-env cleanup; no binaries/checkpoints/npz/logs ingit
